method: One process, one CPU thread, float64. For every world and fit the arms run back to back on the same inputs, with the arm order rotated per call (A,C2,C3 / C2,C3,A / C3,A,C2) so no arm always runs first. Warm-up on two worlds before timing. Nothing else running.
limit: absolute p90 <= 10.74 ms: the ORIGINAL pre-registered limit. The 1.02 x arm-A ratio used in the main study was only the fallback for the cloud machine, where arm A itself exceeded the cap.
